title: Transient analysis observation (frozen v0.1)
description: One measured-or-inferred observation about a learner turn, transient by default. Status: FROZEN v0.1 (Phase 03, 2026-10-20) — the shape is fixed; only capability DATA may change later (Phase 08). Rules encoded here: status=available means value and unit are present, and value 0 is a real measured zero (for example, zero fillers); status=unavailable or insufficient_evidence means value is null — 'no fillers were measurable' must never be reported as zero or as a clean fluency bill. `source` separates `measured` (derived from the learner's own audio by a stated method) from `inferred` (a model's judgment), so inferred claims are never presented as measurements; both are closed enums generated by application code, not free text. `recognitionStatus` records what the recogniser produced, so a missing transcript can never be read as a measured zero; `audioSourceClassification` records the declared source of the measured audio and is a declaration, not a proof of diarization or echo cancellation; `denominator` states which measured duration a rate was divided by, and the two rates may never share one. Each metric key is coupled below to exactly one unit, one method identifier and (for the two rates) one denominator, with a nonnegative domain. What this schema cannot enforce: reliability.limitations strings are trusted application output (they describe measurement limits and must never carry learner or model prose — that is a writer-boundary rule, not a schema check), and schema validation does not prove a detector exists or is validated. Transcription confidence is not a speaking score and has no place in this shape.

metricKey.description: Frozen metric allowlist. Each key is coupled below to exactly one unit, one method identifier and (for the two rates) one denominator: *_ms keys take integer milliseconds, *.count keys take integer counts, *_wpm keys take fractional words_per_minute; all values are nonnegative.

source.description: measured = derived from learner audio by the stated method; inferred = model judgment over audio/transcript evidence.

method.description: Controlled provenance identifier, optional here and required in the durable record. When present it must be the identifier bound to the metric key below. stt_words_over_speech_regions is the pre-freeze identifier of the OVERALL rate and may not be used for the speech-active rate. Stating an identifier does not mean the detector is implemented or validated.

denominator.description: Which measured duration the rate was divided by. `learner_span_ms` is the elapsed learner-audio span (source leading and trailing silence included, end padding excluded); `speech_active_ms` is the VAD-estimated speech-active time on the same sample clock. Neither denominator may ever be total connection time or total session time.

recognitionStatus.description: What the recogniser produced. `measured` = a transcript exists; `no-analyzable-speech` = the recogniser ran and returned nothing analyzable; `missing-transcription` = no transcript was obtained at all. The last two are NOT a measured zero: a rate under them is absent, never 0.

audioSourceClassification.description: Classification of the audio this observation was measured over; only allowed on a `measured` observation. A source label is a DECLARATION, not a proof: it does not establish diarization and it does not establish echo cancellation. Empty, assistant-only, mixed and unknown classifications are refused before a measurement is produced.

status.description: available = a numeric value exists (0 is a value). unavailable = the signal could not be measured at all. insufficient_evidence = there was not enough speech to compute the metric.

value.description: The measured or inferred value; null exactly when status is not `available`. Domain and integer/fractional requirements come from the metric-key rules in the allOf below.

unit.description: Unit of `value`; null exactly when status is not `available`.

evidenceSpan.description: Where in the learner's own audio this observation is anchored, on the learner-audio sample clock. Null when the metric is not audio-localized. These are ESTIMATED REGIONS, not word timings: the reviewed provider documentation documents no word-level timing, so none is derived here. The span INCLUDES the source's leading and trailing silence — it is the elapsed span the learner produced — and EXCLUDES the end padding.

turnId.description: The conversational turn this observation belongs to. A turn is not a speech-to-text segment: one sentence can be split into several segments, so turn grouping is the application's own and is never taken from provider segment boundaries.

span.description: An estimated region on the learner-audio sample clock. startMs <= endMs is a writer-boundary invariant. There is no word-level timing anywhere in this contract.

limitations.description: Plain-word known limitations written by the application's own analysis code — trusted generation, never learner or model prose. Schema validation cannot verify authorship; policing this is a writer-boundary responsibility.
